summary: Stark Novus Financial Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 1.01 to disclose an Omnibus Amendment to Financing Documents. The amendment defers monthly interest payments from June through September 2026 to the closing of a sale of billboard assets in Central Florida, requires a letter of intent by August 2026, applies net sale proceeds to lender obligations, and pledges additional billboard collateral in Missouri and California. This is a routine financing amendment with no acquisition, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation event. The filing is a material definitive agreement, but it does not constitute a special situation. Watch for the Orlando Sale closing and potential defaults.
